hardware: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Developer Kit

exchange.testReceiver: Temporary native-scheme receiver on the user's Mac

memory.note: Measured on the actual Orin. The authenticated figure covers sequential operations in one process, not isolated per-command usage.

limitations: Private Pine scripts, saved private indicators, layouts and strategy reports were not tested.
Watchlist API access was verified; populated-list UI parity was not compared.
A browser-only sign-in page cannot receive the native callback without a user-device client receiver.
Account identifiers, cookies, proof values and callback credentials are deliberately omitted.
